hero.eyebrow: A new approach to waste recovery in Algeria
hero.description: Wastoo is building a platform that connects citizens, collectors, and waste-recovery partners to make waste management more accessible and organized.

problem.heading: Waste deserves a better journey.
problem.lead: Finding the right people, places, and opportunities for waste recovery can be difficult. Wastoo aims to make those connections easier to discover through one accessible digital platform.
problem.discoveryDescription: Help people discover relevant locations and waste-related opportunities.
problem.connectionDescription: Bring citizens and waste-recovery participants closer together.
problem.organizationDescription: Support a more connected and accessible waste-recovery ecosystem.

how.heading: From waste to a better connection.
how.discoverDescription: Find relevant waste-related locations, listings, or opportunities on the platform.
how.discoverScreenAlt: Wastoo app screen showing waste posts and material filters.
how.connectDescription: See who else is part of the ecosystem and what they offer.
how.actionDescription: Use the available platform features to support the next step in the recovery process.

roles.heading: One ecosystem. Different roles.
roles.lead: Wastoo is being developed to make it easier for people and organizations to discover their place in a more connected waste-recovery ecosystem.
roles.citizensDescription: Citizens are participants in a more connected waste-recovery ecosystem.
roles.citizensInApp: Browse posts and the map, then list waste to give away or sell.
roles.collectorsDescription: Collectors are participants in the waste-recovery network Wastoo aims to connect.
roles.centersDescription: Recycling and recovery centers are part of the network Wastoo aims to make easier to discover.

mission.heading: Building a more connected future for waste recovery.
mission.description: We believe that better connections can create better opportunities for waste recovery. Wastoo is being developed to make relevant information and participants easier to discover, helping move toward a more organized and accessible ecosystem in Algeria.
mission.graphicLabel: An abstract network of connected points

launch.heading: Be part of the Wastoo launch.
launch.description: We're working to bring Wastoo to Algeria. Follow our journey and be among the first to hear about the launch.
launch.privacyNotice: Your email app will open so you can contact the Wastoo team. Your address and message will be used to respond to your inquiry.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions.
faq.lead: A little more about Wastoo and where the project stands.
faq.answer1: Wastoo is an Algerian environmental technology project developing a mobile platform intended to connect citizens, waste collectors, and waste-recovery participants.
faq.answer2: The platform is being developed for citizens, collectors, and relevant waste-recovery organizations.
faq.answer3: The application is currently being developed. Follow Wastoo's official channels for launch announcements.
faq.question4: How can I follow the project?
faq.answer4: Visit Wastoo's official social media accounts using the verified links on this page.
